steps.en: Open the plugin marketplace inside Claude Code
steps.zh: 在 Claude Code 里打开插件市场浏览

steps.en: Install one plugin by name from the official directory
steps.zh: 按名字从官方目录装一个插件

steps.en: Claude Code's plugin loader registers the plugin's commands, agents, skills and MCP config
steps.zh: 插件 loader 把命令、agent、skill 与 MCP 配置注册进会话

steps.en: Work as usual — its slash commands appear, its skills and agents fire when relevant
steps.zh: 照常干活——新命令就位，skill 和 agent 到点触发

value.en: Anthropic-maintained building blocks land in your session with one command — no hand-rolled manifests
value.zh: 一条命令装上 Anthropic 维护的现成积木，不用手写 manifest

sources: README.md on main @ fa59bc90 (fetched 2026-09-28), Installation: '/plugin install {plugin-name}@claude-plugins-official'; 'browse for the plugin in /plugin > Discover'
README.md, Structure + Plugin Structure: /plugins (internal) and /external_plugins (third-party); plugin folder with .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .mcp.json, commands/, agents/, skills/
README.md, Plugin names are immutable: renames map in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, read by 'the Claude Code plugin loader'
